title.zh: 有界物理多流体频谱扫描

summary: Run the four literal fluid scan families with independent point solves, explicit state and canonical axis order. Default method 2 contains 101 physical points; method 4 contains 3750.

capability: Run the four literal fluid scan families with independent point solves, explicit state and canonical axis order. Default method 2 contains 101 physical points; method 4 contains 3750.
operation: state, method and grid controls -> bounded frequency spectra
discovery.model: Linear multi-species warm-fluid electromagnetic model with optional relativistic inertia.
discovery.boundary: Local Fourier modes exp(i k.r-i omega t).

identity.relation: Finite fluid wavevector-grid controls to full frequency spectra
identity.definition: Construct the literal method-specific physical grid, map kx=k*sin(theta), kz=k*cos(theta) where applicable, solve each point independently and collect its checked spectrum in canonical axis order.
identity.model: Linear multi-species warm-fluid electromagnetic model with optional relativistic inertia.
identity.coordinates: Cartesian fields; species density and velocity blocks followed by E and B.
identity.boundary: Local Fourier modes exp(i k.r-i omega t).
assumptions: The rotating-pressure Bx contribution uses the direct divergence of the declared pressure tensor.
Relativistic inertia gamma I+gamma^3 vv^T/c^2 excludes the nonrelativistic collision generator.

Fluid constants profile: c2=(2.9979e8 m/s)^2, epsilon0=8.854e-12 F/m, mu0=1/(c2*epsilon0), gamma default5/3. Charge and mass are explicit SI deck inputs; the defaults use q=+/-1.602e-19 C, me=9.109e-31 kg and mp=1.673e-27 kg. Sound speeds are direct inputs; no kB or temperature-to-speed conversion is performed. This is distinct from current kinetic initialization epsilon0=8.8542e-12 F/m.

inputs.name: state
inputs.description: Explicit equilibrium mapping; no global state is read. Fluid fields are produced by fluid_equilibrium_si or fluid_equilibrium_relative_rates.
inputs.constraints: Required fluid fields q,m,n,v,csz2,csp2,epsnx,epsny,rho,B0,gamma,c2,epsilon0,mu0,Pz,Pp,Delta,pressure_frame,velocity_collision; retain nullable beta fields for rendering.

inputs.name: state_scales
inputs.description: Positive diagonal state-coordinate scales used only for numerical conditioning.
inputs.constraints: Finite positive entries. None selects physical density/velocity/electric/magnetic scales; eigenvectors return in original coordinates.

inputs.name: relativistic
inputs.description: Use the derivative of relativistic momentum in each species velocity block.
inputs.constraints: If true, all species speeds must be below c and velocity_collision must vanish.

inputs.name: grid_controls
inputs.description: Explicit mapping of grid keyword controls.
inputs.constraints: Keys scan_k,scan_theta,scan_kx,scan_kz,angle,wave_number only. Defaults: method1 k=0.1,theta=pi/3; method2 k=arange(101)*1e-5,theta=pi/3; method3 k=2,theta=arange(51)*pi/100; method4 kx=.01+.04*arange(75),kz=.01+.04*arange(50). Explicit controls retain source endpoint and axis mapping.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: Physical scan mapping with kx,kz,axis_names,axis_values,w1,w2 and point solution records.
outputs.units: kx,kz m^-1; theta rad; omega rad/s
outputs.dtype: dict[str, numeric arrays or structured metadata]
outputs.constraints: C-order point records include index and full original-unit solution. Canonical axis_names are (single,single) for method1, (k,theta) for methods2/3 and (kx,kz) for method4; method2 has singleton theta and method3 singleton k.

preconditions: Finite inputs satisfying the declared units and shapes.
supported: Methods 1 through 4; default grids and explicitly bounded grids.
Explicit state scaling and collision-free relativistic point solves.
excluded: Implicit root-to-root branch tracking across scan points.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: ValueError or a missing required mapping key rejects invalid inputs.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Dependency, numerical-library, or native-runtime errors propagate; no silent alternate provider.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Any point solver failure aborts the graph; no complete successful scan is returned.
failure_semantics.partial_results: Completed point data are local until the complete scan succeeds.

example.description: Solve a small explicit method-2 grid.
example.code:
from scirel.kinetic.dispersion.multifluid import fluid_equilibrium_si, scan_fluid_corrected
r = scan_fluid_corrected(dict(state=fluid_equilibrium_si(), method=2, grid_controls=dict(scan_k=[1e-5, 2e-5])))
assert r["w1"].shape == (2, 1, 14)
example.expected: The explicit method-2 scan returned w1 with shape (2,1,14) and axis_names=("k","theta"); this is a bounded Python preflight, not native acceptance.

scope: Current SciRel implementation and the repository tests listed in this contract cover the declared public ports and numerical relation.
The example exercises one bounded representative case; it does not extend applicability beyond the declared preconditions.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Direct tests and the bounded example establish only the declared input/output behavior, numerical checks and failure boundaries; they do not establish arbitrary-parameter parity, branch uniqueness, global physical validity, human scientific endorsement or release approval.
known_limitations: Descending frequency sorts are per point and do not identify a continuous physical branch.
Default method 4 is finite but substantially larger than bounded qualification grids.
Example output is a bounded runtime observation, not a universal scientific claim.

references: Xie and Xiao, PDRK: A General Kinetic Dispersion Relation Solver for Magnetized Plasma, Plasma Science and Technology 18 (2016).

nodes.description: Literal method1..4 axes and k*sin(theta),k*cos(theta) mapping; method4 canonical kx-first mesh.
Finite C-order traversal; independent point input bundling and append-only solution collection.
Bounded full original-unit fluid pencil solve for one point.

edges.description: Finite axes and canonical coordinate mesh.
Append a checked point and advance the finite traversal.
Return completed canonical scan arrays and point records.
Unchanged independent point state supplied to the checked solver.
Unchanged independent point kx supplied to the checked solver.
Unchanged independent point kz supplied to the checked solver.
Unchanged independent point relativistic supplied to the checked solver.
Unchanged independent point state_scales supplied to the checked solver.

execution.mode: Bounded sequential traversal of independent spectral points; no cross-point root seed.
execution.ordering: Construct finite axes, traverse np.ndindex in C order, solve each point, append and finally return.
branches: Method1: one k at fixed angle.
Method2: k vector at fixed angle.
Method3: theta vector at fixed k.
execution.state_ownership: Call-local point index and append-only collection; physical state is explicit, with no global kinetic variables.
execution.failure_propagation: Any assembly, solve or residual-validation failure aborts the complete scan.

feedback.state: Finite grid index and accumulated checked point records, not a physical root seed.
feedback.initialization: Empty collection and the first canonical grid index.
feedback.update_order: Prepare independent point, solve and validate, append, advance index.
feedback.continue_when: The point succeeded and an unprocessed grid coordinate remains.
feedback.stop_when: All na*nb points are collected or any point fails.
feedback.iteration_bound: na*nb point attempts; defaults method1=1, method2=101, method3=51, method4=3750.
feedback.nonconvergence: The failed point aborts; no successful partial scan is returned.
